# Protected Architecture & Core Identifiers ("Do Not Edit" Guide)

To maintain system integrity and avoid wiping student learning progress or breaking live course URLs, certain files and core identifiers must **never be modified casually**.

---

## ⛔ 1. Protected Core Identifiers

Changing any of these identifiers will cause **breaking changes** across learner browser storage, progress tracking, and external course bookmarks.

### 1. `courseId` Keys
- `"linux"`
- `"ros2-jazzy"`

> [!CAUTION]
> **Why it's protected**: `courseId` is used as the route path segment (`/courses/ros2-jazzy/...`) and as the primary namespace key in student completion records. Renaming it will break URL routes and cause existing student progress to become orphaned.

### 2. `lessonId` Keys
- E.g., `"ros2-01"`, `"ros2-02"`, `"linux-01"`, `"linux-02"`

> [!CAUTION]
> **Why it's protected**: `completedLessons: string[]` in `localStorage` stores exact lesson IDs. Renaming a lesson ID will cause learners who already completed the lesson to lose their completion checkmark and quiz records.

### 3. `slug` Parameters
- E.g., `"01-introduction"`, `"02-installation"`, `"06-topics"`

> [!CAUTION]
> **Why it's protected**: The static site generator (`generateStaticParams`) builds static HTML based on `slug`. Changing slugs changes the public URL, breaking external links and search engine indexes.

### 4. Progress LocalStorage Key
- `src/lib/store/progressStore.ts`:
  ```typescript
  name: "redbrick_robotics_progress_v2"
  ```

> [!CAUTION]
> **Why it's protected**: Renaming this storage key will immediately reset all progress, quiz scores, and settings for all existing users to zero.

---

## 🚫 2. Generated Files & Build Artifacts (Never Edit Manually)

Never attempt to manually modify or commit the following directories or files:

1. **`node_modules/`**: Managed exclusively by npm.
2. **`.next/`**: Generated by Next.js during `dev` or `build`.
3. **`dist_test/`**: Generated by the test suite.
4. **`package-lock.json` (Manual Editing)**: Never manually edit `package-lock.json` in a text editor. Only update dependencies via standard npm commands (e.g. `npm install <package>`).
5. **`tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`**: Incremental compiler cache created by `tsc`.
6. **`next-env.d.ts`**: Automatically managed by Next.js; manual additions will be overwritten on the next build.

---

## 🔒 3. Core Engine Files (Require Senior Review)

The following files contain algorithmic calculations and type mappings:
- `src/lib/simulator/virtualFileSystem.ts`
- `src/lib/simulator/completion/completionEngine.ts`
- `src/types/course.ts`

Any edits to these files must be accompanied by unit test updates (`npm run test`) and verified with `npm run typecheck`.
